name: Compañía y factoría (Seville partnership with a resident factor-partner in the Indies)
key_source: SCOPE, AS FIXED BY THE MAINTAINER BEFORE CODING (bundle README, compania-sevilla-2026-11-19): a partnership contracted before a Seville notary for trade with the Indies, in which one or more partners supply the capital and another partner travels to the Indies, resides there and manages the sale and reinvestment of the goods, for a share of the profit. Commission agency (encomienda, comisión: sale of another's goods for a percentage) is OUT of scope as a form. Its relation to comanda and commenda is a comparison, not an identity. SOURCE: Martínez Gijón, J., 'La práctica del comercio por intermediario en el tráfico con las Indias durante el siglo XVI', Anuario de Historia del Derecho Español 40 (1970), 5-84; Apéndice documental, pp. 43-83, ten deeds of the Archivo de Protocolos de Sevilla, Oficio XV, read in full from the page images. Spelling modernised by the editor (p. 43, note). NOT YET IN references/works.csv: a row must be added before application (check_citations.py). INSTANCES ASSIGNED, FROM THE CLAUSES AND NOT THE RUBRICS (records file INSTANCES-compania-sevilla-2026-11-19.csv on application): doc 2 (Vallecillo, 1516, Santo Domingo, two years, traveller puts in half the capital, profit and loss halved); doc 3 (Cazalla, 1542, Nombre de Dios, six years, 3,000 ducados against the factor's 80, 3/4-1/4, loss pro rata to stake); doc 8 (Cazalla, 1550, Lima, four years, three capital partners, factor puts in nothing, 3/4-1/4, loss charged as profit is shared); doc 9 (Cazalla, 1542, Nombre de Dios, four years, two brothers, factor puts in nothing, 3/4-1/4, loss on the capital partners). Doc 10 (Cazalla, 1549) is a power that recites such a company; corroboration only. NOT ASSIGNED: docs 4 and 5 (commission at 5 % and 6 %), docs 6 and 7 (salaried factors; doc 7's rubric 'COMPAÑÍA' is the editor's), doc 1 (power of attorney). SCOPE IN TIME AND PLACE IS WHAT THE ASSIGNED DEEDS SHOW: Seville, 1516-1550, two notaries of Oficio XV, destinations Santo Domingo, Nombre de Dios and Lima. FOUR INSTANCES, NOT INDEPENDENT: three of the four are one notary (Cazalla), two of them in one book of 1542; doc 8 and doc 10 are one firm. THE SCOPED FORM IS HETEROGENEOUS ON THE CONTRACTUAL-FORM CELLS. It ties 2:2 on CF1 and CF3 (docs 2, 3 against 8, 9) and splits 3:1 on CF2 (doc 8 the minority) and LR6 (doc 9 the minority), and no single split resolves all four; see the coding notes. CODED 2026-11-19 by ai (claude-opus-5-5, high), blind first coding; unreviewed. 33 cells: 13 substantive, 17 .NR, 3 .NA.
